name: Tny
description: Tny is a powerful URL shortening service designed to simplify link management and enhance online marketing strategies. With Tny, users can easily create, share, and track shortened URLs, making it an essential tool for digital marketers and businesses looking to optimize their online presence.

events.d: Generate a Tny shortened link from a provided long URL and return the short URL.
Unshortens a URL. Follows all redirects and returns the final destination of a URL.
